description: Run the full 10-question VAT compliance gap analysis. Returns compliance score (0–100), risk band, itemised findings with Article citations, and source verification per finding.

answers.description: Q1..Q10 answers. Q1=ISO country, Q2=array of supply types, Q3=B2B|B2C|MIXED, Q4=array of countries, Q5A=annual cross-border B2C revenue in EUR (numeric; legacy strings under_10k/over_10k/unsure still accepted), Q6=array of registration countries or ['NONE'], Q7B=UNION|IOSS|NONE, Q8=array of marketplaces, Q9=yes|no, Q10=under|over|both|na.

name: vat_compliance_full
